'''''Geranium dissectum''''' or '''cut-leaved crane's-bill'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007|access-date=2014-10-17}}</ref> is a plant species of the genus ''[[Geranium]]''. It is native to [[Europe]].

It can be found on other continents as well, in some instances as an [[introduced species]]. It can be found in North America, where it is known as the '''cutleaf geranium'''.<ref>BONAP’s Taxonomic Data Center (TDC)
North American Vascular Flora</ref>

Extracts of ''Geranium dissectum'' are reported to improve germination rates of [[Hemp]] seeds.<ref>Muminović, Š. (1990). Alelopatski efekti ekstrakta nekih korova na klijavost sjemena usjeva. ''Fragmenta herbologica Jugoslavica'', ''9''(2), 93–102.</ref>
